indicators.name: Simple Moving Average
indicators.description: The plain average of the source price over the last N sessions, every session weighted the same.

indicators.name: Exponential Moving Average
indicators.description: An average of the source price over N sessions that weights recent sessions more, so it turns sooner than the SMA.

indicators.name: Weighted Moving Average
indicators.description: An average of the source price over N sessions with linearly rising weights: the newest session counts most.

indicators.name: Hull Moving Average
indicators.description: A moving average built from weighted averages over N and N/2 sessions, so it follows price closely with little lag.

indicators.name: Kaufman Adaptive Moving Average
indicators.description: A moving average that speeds up while price trends cleanly and slows down while it moves sideways (efficiency over N sessions).

params.label: Holders
params.text: Top-K: at each session the K brokers with the largest positive inventory over the lookback (ties by broker code); selected: the brokers named; all: every broker with a row in the loaded window.

params.label: Brokers
params.text: Read with holders "Selected brokers": 1 to 5 broker codes.

params.label: Top K
params.text: Read with holders "Top-K holders" (the Terminal draws at most 5 brokers).

params.label: Series
options: c · Inventory ÷ traded value of the lookback (%)
params.text: a: the Terminal's cumulative inventory counted from the first of the lookback's sessions; b: the Terminal's daily net; c: a as a percent of every investor's traded value on the chosen boards over the same sessions.

params.label: Lookback (sessions)
params.text: The L sessions ending at the evaluated candle: the inventory counts from the first of them; Top-K holders are ranked on it; series c divides by their traded value.

params.label: Holders that moved: by at least
params.text: Read by output count, in the series' unit: lots or rupiah for a and b, percent of the traded value for c; a holder counts when its series is above 0 and at least this (rose) or below 0 and at most minus this (fell).

flows.formula: Series a: the Terminal's Broker Inventory (cumulative net lots or rupiah) of each holder, counted from the first of the last L sessions, summed over the holders; b: the Terminal's daily net of the holders; c: 100 x the holders' inventory over the L sessions / every investor's traded value (gross buy) on the chosen boards over the same sessions. Holders: the K brokers with the largest positive inventory over the L sessions, the brokers named, or every broker. Output count: how many holders' series rose (fell) by at least the amount.
flows.misuse: An inventory is a net of the broker's clients over the sessions counted, not a holding: it starts at zero on the first of them. Series a and b scale with the stock's size (use c to compare stocks).

flows.misuse: The brokers' classification is today's, not the one of the day the trades happened: the value is read only at the latest broker date, and is n/a on any earlier session (also inside an operator over its history).

flows.name: Foreign Net Value
flows.tip: Foreign investors' net buying (buy value minus sell value) in rupiah over the last sessions.
flows.formula: Sum over the last D sessions of the buy value minus the sell value of every broker row with investor type Foreign on the chosen boards (every board by default), in rupiah; missing unless the session has broker data and the D sessions start at or after the stock's first session with broker data.
flows.misuse: Investor type, not broker domicile. A rupiah amount grows with the stock's size (Net Flow / Turnover Ratio with all brokers and Foreign investors compares stocks). One Nego block can dominate on every board.

flows.name: Major-Holder Net Change (KSEI)
flows.tip: Net change of the 5% holders' stakes reported to KSEI over the last sessions.
flows.formula: Sum of the KSEI-reported changes (percentage points of the shares) of the stock's major holders with a position date in the last D sessions.
flows.misuse: KSEI dates are position-report dates and many prices are estimates; not point-in-time for past dates.

candles.name: Hammer

params.label: Prior trend measured by
params.meaning: How the trend before the pattern is read, on the session before its candle: average = the close is below (a bullish pattern) or above (a bearish one) its own average of the last trend-length sessions; change = below / above the close trend-length sessions earlier. The test cannot be switched off: the trend is what tells this pattern from its same-shape pair.

params.label: Trend sessions
params.meaning: Sessions of the average, or how many sessions back the change is measured.

params.label: Minimum range (ticks)
params.meaning: Every candle of the pattern spans at least this many price ticks of its price band (IDX tick sizes from Rp 1 below Rp 200 to Rp 25 from Rp 5,000); a narrower candle is too coarse to show a shape.

params.label: Body at most (% of range)
params.meaning: The body is at most this share of the candle's range.

params.label: Long shadow at least (x body)
params.meaning: The long shadow is at least this multiple of the body.

params.label: Other shadow at most (% of range)
params.meaning: The shadow on the other side is at most this share of the range.

candles.formula: Hammer (1 candle, flagged on the last): the candle traded (volume above 0, never a day without trades) and spans at least min_range_ticks IDX price ticks; trend before candle 1 down (trend = average: close below its trend_length-session average; change: below the close trend_length sessions earlier; none: no test); rules: 100 x body1 <= body_max_pct x range1; lower1 >= shadow_ratio x body1; 100 x upper1 <= short_shadow_pct x range1.
candles.interpretation: After a decline, one candle with a small body at the top of its range and a long lower shadow: sellers pushed the price down and buyers took it back by the close.
candles.misuse: A Hammer and a Hanging Man are the same shape; only the trend before tells them apart, so the trend test cannot be switched off. A single candle is weak evidence on its own; confirm with the next session or another condition. A day without trades or a missing bar is never a candle of a pattern, and every candle spans at least the minimum range in price ticks of its price band (IDX tick sizes). Prices are the series the Screener reads (adjusted for corporate actions as the price data is).

params.label: Minimum range (ticks)
params.meaning: Every candle of the pattern spans at least this many price ticks of its price band (IDX tick sizes from Rp 1 below Rp 200 to Rp 25 from Rp 5,000); a narrower candle is too coarse to show a shape.

params.label: Lows equal within (ticks)
params.meaning: The two lows are at most this many price ticks apart (0 = exactly equal).

candles.formula: Tweezer Bottom (2 candles, flagged on the last): each of the 2 candles traded (volume above 0, never a day without trades) and spans at least min_range_ticks IDX price ticks; trend before candle 1 down (trend = average: close below its trend_length-session average; change: below the close trend_length sessions earlier; none: no test); rules: dir1 < 0; dir2 > 0; ticks(low1, low2) <= tolerance_ticks.
candles.interpretation: After a decline, a black candle and then a white candle with the same low (within the tolerance): the low was tested twice and held.
candles.misuse: The lows are compared in price ticks, so the tolerance means the same on a Rp 100 stock and a Rp 9,000 stock. Weak alone. A day without trades or a missing bar is never a candle of a pattern, and every candle spans at least the minimum range in price ticks of its price band (IDX tick sizes). Prices are the series the Screener reads (adjusted for corporate actions as the price data is).

params.label: Average body of (sessions)
params.meaning: The sessions before the pattern whose average body a long candle is measured against.

params.label: Long body (x average)
params.meaning: A long candle's body is at least this multiple of the average body; 0 switches the size test off (the average still needs its sessions).

params.label: Star body at most (% of the first)
params.meaning: The middle candle's body is at most this share of the first candle's body.

params.label: Star may reach into the first body (%)
params.meaning: The relaxed body gap: the star's body top is at most this share of the first body above the first candle's close (0 = touching; negative = a real gap of that size).

params.label: Third closes into the first body at least (%)
params.meaning: The third candle closes at least this share of the first body above the first candle's close.
